facts.section: Income statements · three months ended June 30, 2025
Income statements · three months ended June 30, 2024

notes.keywords: azure growth cloud services revenue currency
notes.text: Revenue for Azure and other cloud services rose 39% year over year in both reported and constant-currency terms.

notes.keywords: capex cap ex capital expenditures finance leases cash spending investment
notes.text: Quarterly capital spending was $24.2 billion, including $6.5 billion in finance leases. Cash payments for property and equipment were $17.1 billion.

notes.keywords: azure datacenter data center capacity constrained constraint guidance outlook demand
notes.text: At the July 2025 call, management expected Azure capacity constraints to last through the first half of FY26, even as it added datacenter capacity.

notes.keywords: microsoft cloud revenue growth currency total
notes.text: Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $46.7 billion, growing 27% year over year as reported and 25% in constant currency.
